title: Live-test input never leaves the device under test
context: On 2026-09-24 the committed macOS harness injected input system-wide (System Events keystrokes and HID-tap CGEvents) and re-activated the probe before every key. During a 2,200-chord undo run it took the owner's keyboard and mouse away and the Mac had to be restarted. The owner then required that testing never freeze their I/O again.
options: Keep system-wide input and add a kill switch
In-app native NSEvent injection through a probe method channel, plus a hardware-input watchdog
Run macOS tests in a virtual machine
outcome: macOS: in-app NSEvent injection (NSApp.postEvent to the probe's own window, device-dependent modifier bits, explicit flagsChanged) with the HID-tap watchdog, idle gate and owner-approved keep-awake. postToPid was tried and rejected (mouse events dropped, Cmd chords never register). A VM was offered and not chosen. Android: adb input only, which never touches the Mac; keep-screen-on comes from FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON in the probe build, not from phone settings.
